items.title: Did Warren Buffett’s Shift to Chairman Emeritus Just Reshape Berkshire Hathaway's (BRK.A) Governance Narrative?
items.summary: Earlier this week, Berkshire Hathaway announced that Warren Buffett has stepped down as chairman and become chairman emeritus, with his son Howard Buffett appointed non-executive chairman while Greg Abel continues as CEO and Susan Decker remains lead independent director. This move completes Berkshire’s long-telegraphed succession plan, formally separating board oversight, day-to-day management, and founder influence in a three-person leadership structure.
